M3-C06-02 PROVISIONAL (act1_ch06.md §5): Inquisitor Hadric Moll, a person (the character track builds him), never killed. tags stillguard: Toma's offensive skills are forbidden on him (encounters.json ch06_inquisitor forbidden_skills). yield_at_hp_pct 0: at 0 HP he goes to one knee and yields. M3-CMB-01 (act1_ch08.md §5, §5a; set_piece_battles.md). PROVISIONAL (creatures track's id): a gull-shaped hole in the rain. It dives a hauled rope (strips the Climb's Haste); otherwise it pecks. High evasion.
M3-CMB-01 (act1_ch08.md §5, §5a; set_piece_battles.md). PROVISIONAL: a spawn-polyp rooted on the Watchers' stones, healing the crawlers. Rooted: Storm-Call can't move it (spares_tag).

M3-CMB-01 (act1_ch08.md §5, §5a; set_piece_battles.md). PROVISIONAL: a limb of the Undertow, not a spawn; it can't be beaten (ADR 0017 (c)). hp_floor_pct 30: it never falls before the Breach. Phase 1 the Grip (Close the Hand on the Climb, telegraphed 2 turns); 2 the Dark at 60% (storm_dark: Darkness on the party each turn, the Climb Slowed; two Squall Wings bound to it; Virel's Flare Line clears it); 3 the Breach at 30% (untargetable and damage-immune, Breach telegraphed 4 turns and re-charging, the Surge joins). M3-C08-02 (act1_ch08.md §2 B04-B05, §9 Creatures 5): not spawn. A huge soot-moth drawn up the spire by the keeping flame; it drinks fire and sheds soot. Ysolde's frost.

M4-C10-03 (act2_roster.md Ch10): the reef crab's mangrove cousin, bark-brown and lichen-spotted, that drags prey into the roots every third turn. A shell: Toma's. No model yet (a variant on the reef crab's rig, M3-CRE-620).

M4-C10-03 (act2_roster.md Ch10): the sail leech's fen kin, ribbon-flat, its underside a faint tannin-amber. It should drain (the roster's first lesson in denying healing): request M4-CMB-1001; until then its bite poisons. No model yet (a variant on the sail leech's rig).

M4-C11-03: a long-spined urchin from where the deep's cold wells up, rime on its spines. Spines turn blades (high defence, low magic defence): Ysolde's magic answers it. No model yet.

M4-C12-03 (act2_roster.md Ch12, Keth Pass): a high-pass lynx in its slate winter coat. It goes for the weakest (the roster's back row first; the formation lesson waits on row targeting), pouncing every other turn. No model yet.
M4-C12-03: a pale moth whose larvae live in old keth cords; the knots on its wings are real keth knots (Ysolde can read one). Every third turn it unravels a buff. No model yet.
M4-C12-03: the slag tortoise's mountain cousin, its shell frost-split scree. The armour-break niche again in the cold: Kerrid. No model yet (a variant on the slag tortoise's rig).

M4-C16-03: tide crawlers bleached chalky by days of white water, their wounds dimmer. The swarm in the open, no wall to hold: three at a time. Toma. No model yet (a variant on the tide crawler's rig).

M5-A3P-1009 (act3_ch19.md §5; the chapters combat seat): Ilsabet Rue, the scribe who keeps Warden Hesper Oan's watch roll, held alive by bound light for four hundred years. She is the roll: only Ysolde's reading breaks it (answered_by; the Order's script against its scribe). Every third turn she reads it back to Hesper (Protect on both); between, she notes a hero down (a light blow and a Slow). While she stands Hesper answers blows (her counter stance); once the roll is broken Hesper fights plainly (her phase's when_down). She leaves with Hesper (leaves_with). When they fall they lie still. PROVISIONAL numbers; no model yet.

M5-A3P-1009 (act3_ch19.md §5; the chapters combat seat): Warden Hesper Oan, one of the Abiding, held alive by bound light at her post. The watch-roll is the brief's mechanic as the engine can play it: while Ilsabet's roll stands, every third turn Hesper takes an answering stance (a counter until her next turn) and the roll's reading Protects her; break the roll (Ysolde, on Ilsabet) or bring her to half and she fights plainly, harder. Kerrid answers her (role_answer; the dead to the dead). No yield: when she falls she lies still (rule 4). PROVISIONAL numbers; no model yet.
